concept.concept: Dark-background shirt with a detailed hand-drawn Orion constellation map and the phrase 'I Stay Up Late for This' beneath it
concept.audience: Amateur astronomers and night-sky enthusiasts who attend star parties and use backyard telescopes
concept.rationale: Orion becomes prominent in fall skies making this seasonally timed, the humor resonates with the niche's identity, dark shirts with star art have strong visual appeal on product mockups, astronomy communities are passionate buyers

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Stay Up Late for This" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of the Orion constellation map with bold geometric star points connected by clean straight lines forming the classic hunter figure. Use 4 solid colors: bright white stars, light cyan connecting lines, deep navy background, and one accent color in gold for the brightest stars (Betelgeuse and Rigel). Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition on a deep navy solid background with generous margins. The constellation lines form a connected unified shape in the center. All elements stay away from edges. Design reads clearly at 12x16 inches from across a room. Screen-print aesthetic with sharp clean edges and high contrast.
design.text_on_design: I Stay Up Late for This
design.style: Bold sans-serif, all caps, solid white, positioned directly below the constellation in a horizontal line, simple and legible

verdict.reason: The Orion constellation is a public domain astronomical subject with no trademark concerns. The combination of a star map with this casual observational humor is a common genre in astronomy-themed apparel and presents no identifiable IP risk.

listing.title: I Stay Up Late Orion Constellation Stargazing T-Shirt
